reviewer.note: docs/reviews/2026-11-04-woodland-water.md, round 7 (e2a3c545). Fixed: K6-1 as written (fall_value passes on every frame, own measure), P6-1 (each edge steps every 4 to 8 rows, water 4 film on the west column), the tongue seam (now a checker), L6-1 (the PNG sheet equals fall_sheet(9 + c) frame 0 texel for texel, and the woodland_kit bake equals waterfall_3_tall's PNG on the whole sheet body). No overshoot in brightness: on the woodland sheet alone (x 216-258, y 790-870; round 6's box took in 4 to 5 columns of the navy recess) the sibling measures mean 177, east half 165, sd 56, 43 % over 230 L and 33 % of its east third under 100 L; the kit's means sit within -6 to +10 L of it. Fails on K7-1: the value range is compressed and leaves the sibling's ladder. The kit has neither the sibling's whitest whites (18 to 27 % over 230 L against 43 %) nor its shaded east (4 to 20 % of the east third under 100 L against 33 %; the navy edge is one texel in most rows, an off-by-one in fall_sheet: xr - X <= edge_w gives edge_w texels, not edge_w + 1), sd 42 to 45 against 56, and its second lane palette brings in snow 2 and snow 3 (lilac-grey, hue 228 and 216), tones the woodland sheet never uses, up to 28 % of an east third. At game scale beside Bramble it reads as a pale chalky curtain with no core shadow on the right, against the sibling's white streaks falling to a shaded east side. Round 6's fix line "the dark tones only in the last 2 to 4 texels" misread the sibling and is withdrawn: its dark tones are broken streaks through the east third. Fix (feasibility-checked on all eight pieces and frames, fall_value, fall_grain and the flat-area cap still passing): FALL_LANE_TONES on the ladder only, disjoint per zone, e.g. palette 0 W (water 4, snow 5, snow 5, snow 5), M (water 3, snow 4, snow 4, snow 4), E (water 3, water 5, water 5, water 5); palette 1 W (water 5, snow 4, snow 4, snow 4), M (water 4, snow 5, snow 5, snow 5), E (water 2, snow 4, snow 4, snow 4); the east edge edge_w 2 or 3; add to fall_value sd at least 48, east third under 100 L at least 0.15, over 230 L at least 0.28, and no snow 0 to 3 in the body. Polish P7-2: the foam leaves the foot bare for up to 9 to 16 texels on the wider pieces (frame 0, which the bakes show). P7-3: the tongue's checker is a rectangle with straight sides. Measured on this piece: mean 171, east half 161, sd 45, east third under 100 L 20 %, over 230 L 18 %, middle third over 200 L 0.44 (0.40 lowest), east navy edge 1 texel in 49 of 84 rows, snow 2 23 % of the east third.
